responsibility: Declares the shared reachability state used by Rust privacy analysis. It introduces the ReachLevel enum and the PrivacyContext interface for updating and querying per-definition reachability in Analysis::NodeMapping/DefId space, giving reachability visitors and later privacy checks a common container for whether HIR items are considered reachable or unreachable.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration half of the privacy-context pair: unlike rust-privacy-ctx.cc, it introduces ReachLevel and the PrivacyContext API and storage shape, but not the update logic or selftests.
